summary:
Iter 10 – Manager dashboard mobile layout cleanup + PrintNode backend hardening: ALL requested flows PASS 100% on the public preview URL. No regressions. No blocking issues. One pre-existing non-blocking RN-web warning still present (shadow* -> boxShadow).

BACKEND (2/2 pass, new file /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_print_hardening.py, -n 0): (a) Fresh web POST /api/orders (pickup, Margherita 32cm) created a PENDING order; POST /api/orders/{id}/print returned 409 with 'not accepted yet – the ticket prints on acceptance'. (b) POST /api/orders/{id}/accept {minutes:20} moved status to Acceptée, order.printed=true, print_status='simulated', print_attempts=1; GET /api/print-jobs shows EXACTLY ONE job for this order_id with kind='kitchen' & status='simulated'. (c) Second POST /print (no force) -> 409 'Ticket already printed'. (d) POST /print {force:true} -> 200, ok=true, print_status='simulated', print_attempts=2, body.text contains 'REIMPRESSION'; jobs now sorted kinds == ['kitchen','reprint'], both status=simulated.

FRONTEND MOBILE 390x844 (manager PIN 1234): (1) Header shows title 'Tableau de bord'; staff-back, staff-sound-toggle, staff-lock all visible. Horizontally scrollable nav row: staff-go-kitchen -> /staff/kitchen, staff-go-phone-orders -> /phone-orders, staff-go-customers -> /staff/customers, staff-go-closing -> /staff/closing, staff-go-admin -> /staff/admin all navigate correctly; browser back returns to dashboard with title intact. (2) Segmented filter staff-filters: staff-filter-new/progress/done switch the list, counts shown (e.g. 45 / 41 / 14), no visual overlap with header/cards on 390-wide viewport. (3) First-delivery card (first-delivery-toggle) is COLLAPSED by default on mobile: first-delivery-lunch-11:30 is NOT visible; first-delivery-summary shows 'Midi dès 11:00 · Soir dès 17:00'. Tap toggle -> chips appear; tap first-delivery-lunch-11:30 -> toast + summary becomes 'Midi 11:30 · Soir dès 17:00'; tap first-delivery-lunch-open -> summary reverts to 'Midi dès 11:00 · Soir dès 17:00'. (4) Order card #1375 (web pickup) shows #number, status badge 'En attente de confirmation', tags Web/RETRAIT, Commandée/Souhaitée time cells, customer 'TEST_Ui1 · 0790000201', items '1x Margherita 32cm', total CHF 14.00, CTA 'Accepter et confirmer'. Tap opens staff-order-detail modal with staff-detail-close visible. (5) PENDING #1375 accept: tap staff-accept-20 -> tap staff-accept-confirm -> status becomes 'Acceptée' and staff-print-status reads 'Imprimé 18:19 · 1x · simulated'. REJECT flow on #1376: staff-reject-button -> fill staff-reject-reason 'TEST reject' -> staff-reject-confirm -> modal auto-closes; order removed from Nouvelles list (count went 45 -> 43 after both actions). (6) IN-PROGRESS delivery #1377 (accepted phone order assigned via UI): detail modal shows sections next steps (staff-status-preparing, staff-status-ready), Livreur (staff-assign-1/2/3 – clicking staff-assign-1 renders staff-detail-driver badge), Retard (staff-delay-5/10/15 + staff-delay-time-input + staff-delay-custom-time – tapping staff-delay-5 updates staff-confirmed-time from 18:48 -> 18:53), Annuler la commande (staff-cancel-order), and Ticket & reçu (staff-print-button, staff-ticket-preview, staff-receipt-preview, staff-print-status). Tap staff-ticket-preview navigates to /staff/ticket/6aac12f3f72e927f8996e081 with 'Aperçu ticket 80 mm' header (modal closed cleanly before route change – no ghost overlay).

FRONTEND TABLET 1024x768 (manager PIN 1234): Two-column layout works: nav row shows all buttons expanded, first-delivery-lunch-11:30 chip visible by default (expanded), left pane lists 43 cards, right pane auto-selects first card and renders full OrderDetail with #1372 header, customer TEST TVA, articles list, no staff-detail-close (twoCol mode doesn't pass onClose). Manager-only nav (Clôture livreurs, Administration) visible in the toolbar.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic RN-web console warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Same as iter7/8/9. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carried over from iter7/8/9) – Migrate deprecated shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow to silence RN-web warnings across the app.
critical_code_review_comments: staff/index.tsx cleanly separates header (title + sound + lock + horizontal nav ScrollView) from the segmented filter and the manager-only <FirstDeliveryControl defaultOpen={twoCol} /> – no overlap on 390-wide viewport. Nav row uses ScrollView horizontal + gap:8, buttons have min height 40 and horizontal padding 14 so all 5 shortcuts are reachable on iPhone SE.

first-delivery.tsx: defaultOpen={twoCol} keeps the card collapsed on phones (summary-only) and expanded on tablets/desktop as required. Chip save flow calls setFirstDelivery via react-query mutation and toasts 'Enregistré' on success. All chips carry testID first-delivery-<key>-<value|open>.

staff-order.tsx: OrderDetail is well-scoped – pending state shows the 2-step accept + reject block, in-progress state shows Next Step / Driver / Delay / Cancel / Ticket sections, closed state hides all mutations. openStaffScreen correctly delays router.push by 350ms when running inside a Modal (mobile) so the ticket page opens on top of a closed modal – verified in flow (6) above.

Backend do_print (server.py L1316-1354) enforces exact idempotency: 409 if pending, 409 if already printed and !force, durable print_lock document field prevents duplicate simultaneous auto-prints. Reprints flip is_reprint=true which is used to build_ticket(...reprint=True) => 'REIMPRESSION' marker, and record a separate 'reprint' entry in print_jobs. Simulated status is correctly returned when PRINTNODE_API_KEY is empty – confirmed via /api/orders/{id}/ticket printer_configured=false.
seed_data_creation: Orders created via public API (BASE=EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): #1375 web pickup TEST_Ui1 0790000201 (accepted through UI, printed simulated); #1376 web pickup TEST_Ui2 0790000202 (rejected through UI); #1377 phone delivery for existing customer 0791751450 Anna Rossi (accepted via /phone-orders, assigned to Livreur 1 via UI, delayed +5 min). Additional throwaway TEST_Print 0790000123 pickup orders created and consumed by test_iter10_print_hardening.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 10 review verified end-to-end. TestID cheat-sheet used: staff-pin-input/submit, staff-dashboard-title, staff-back, staff-sound-toggle, staff-lock, staff-go-kitchen/-phone-orders/-customers/-closing/-admin, staff-filters, staff-filter-new/-progress/-done, first-delivery-toggle, first-delivery-summary, first-delivery-lunch-<open|11:15|11:30|11:45|12:00|closed>, first-delivery-evening-<open|17:15|17:30|17:45|18:00|closed>, staff-order-card-<id>, staff-order-detail, staff-detail-close, staff-detail-status, staff-detail-driver, staff-detail-number, staff-detail-total, staff-requested-time, staff-confirmed-time, staff-accept-15/20/30/40/45/60, staff-accept-confirm, staff-accept-custom-time, staff-custom-time-input, staff-confirm-requested-time, staff-reject-button, staff-reject-reason, staff-reject-cancel, staff-reject-confirm, staff-status-preparing/-ready/-picked_up/-delivering/-delivered/-completed, staff-assign-1/2/3, staff-delay-5/10/15, staff-delay-time-input, staff-delay-custom-time, staff-cancel-order, staff-print-status, staff-print-button, staff-ticket-preview, staff-receipt-preview. Print/reprint backend behaviour is idempotent + gated by print_lock; simulated when PRINTNODE_API_KEY is empty (do NOT set the key – it's expected per spec).
